label: Where It Happened
lede: Berlin stories told where they happened. Listen to the episodes and follow the text as I explore the places behind them.

lead.title: The Hill Made of a City: Where It Happened, Episode 8
lead.excerpt: Episode 8 of Where It Happened: an unfinished Nazi-era college buried under the rubble of bombed-out Berlin, the American and British listening station on the summit, and why the whole Teufelsberg is now a listed monument.
lead.alt: The tower and radar domes of the former listening station on the Teufelsberg above autumn trees
